==Ingredients==
* 2 boneless, skinless [[Cookbook:chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] (45 [[Cookbook:milliliter|milliliter]]s) [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 3½ [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[Cookbook:Common Mushroom|white mushrooms]]
* 3½ ounces (100 g) [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Pimento|pimentos]] or other mild [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile peppers]]
* 3 tablespoons (42 g) [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
* 3 tablespoons (23 g) [[Cookbook:Flour#Wheat flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 13½–14½ [[Cookbook:Fluid Ounce|US fl. oz.]] (400–430 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Chicken Broth|chicken broth]] (depending on the size of can or jar available in your area)

==Procedure==
# Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper and garlic powder and then [[Cookbook:Cube|cube]] them into bite-size pieces.
# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] the chicken cubes, onion, mushrooms, and pimentos in the olive oil in a [[Cookbook:skillet|skillet]].
# In a [[Cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]], melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook over medium heat for about a minute.
# Add the chicken broth and stir till thickened.
# Add the sauce to the chicken and vegetable mixture; stir together and cook a few more minutes.
# Serve over [[Cookbook:Buttermilk Biscuits|biscuits]], [[Cookbook:toast|toast]] or toasted [[Cookbook:English Muffins|English muffins]].

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* You can add 1–2 cloves of finely diced [[Cookbook:garlic|garlic]] to the chicken and vegetable mixture; add it last, when the chicken is almost done, because garlic burns quickly.
* You can serve over [[Cookbook:rice|rice]] or [[Cookbook:pasta|pasta]] instead of biscuits, toast or English muffins.
